#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    long long b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> a(n);
    vector<int> c(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
        c[i] = (a[i] % 2 == 0) ? 1 : -1;
    }
    long long sum = 0;
    int zeroCount = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        sum += c[i];
        if (sum == 0) zeroCount++;
    }
    vector<int> diffs(zeroCount);
    sum = 0;
    int idx = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        sum += c[i];
        if (sum == 0) {
            diffs[idx++] = abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]);
        }
    }
    sort(diffs.begin(), diffs.end());
    long long total = 0;
    int count = 0;
    for (int d : diffs) {
        if (total + d <= b) {
            total += d;
            count++;
        } else break;
    }
    cout << count << endl;
    return 0;
}
